zh.title: 國防部通報偵獲共機21架次 15架次越過海峽中線及延伸線
zh.summary: 國防部11月21日另行通報，越線軍機活動涉及臺灣周邊中部及西南空域。
body: 國防部11月21日通報，當天偵獲21架次中國軍機出海活動，其中15架次越過臺灣海峽中線及其延伸線，進入臺灣周邊中部及西南空域。國防部表示，相關活動也有中國軍艦配合。
另據國防部同日發布的例行公報，截至上午6時的前24小時，軍方偵獲共機2架次、共艦6艘及公務船1艘。兩架次軍機均進入公報所列的西南及東部空域。
例行公報和後續新聞稿各有不同統計時段。國防部將後續活動稱為中共所謂的聯合戰備警巡，並表示國軍持續監控與應處。

en.title: Taiwan reports 21 PLA aircraft sorties, 15 crossing the Taiwan Strait median line or its extension
en.summary: Taiwan’s defence ministry reported aircraft activity in central and southwestern areas around Taiwan in a separate November 21 statement.
body: Taiwan’s Ministry of National Defense reported 21 sorties by Chinese military aircraft on November 21. It said 15 crossed the Taiwan Strait median line or its extension and entered central and southwestern areas around Taiwan. Chinese naval vessels were also reported in connection with the activity.

In an earlier daily bulletin covering the 24 hours ending at 6 a.m., the ministry recorded two Chinese military aircraft sorties, six naval vessels and one government vessel. The two aircraft sorties entered areas described in the bulletin as southwestern and eastern.
The two reports cover different periods. The ministry said Taiwanese forces monitored and responded to the later activity, which it described as a joint combat readiness patrol.

facts.claim: The ministry reported 21 sorties on November 21, including 15 crossing the median line or its extension.
The statement reported activity in central and southwestern areas around Taiwan.
The ministry said Taiwanese forces monitored and responded.
